+    reports basic identity information about the disks of the system, as well as the key health parameters
+    of NVMe and ATA disks, by implementing the <constant>io.systemd.Metrics</constant> Varlink interface on a
+    <para>All whole-disk block devices backed by hardware are reported, i.e. partitions, loopback devices,
+    device mapper devices and other virtual block devices, as well as drives without a medium, are skipped.
+    Only block devices that have been fully probed by
+    are considered. The metric object is the device node of the block device, for example
+    <filename>/dev/nvme0n1</filename> or <filename>/dev/sda</filename>. No metric fields are set.</para>

+        <listitem><para>The size of the disk in bytes.</para>
